commands.note: Fedora 44 uses DNF5. The catalog exposes only syntax shared with the curated DNF command model until DNF5-specific options are modeled.
APT is not the native package manager for Fedora 44.
Fedora 44 uses the util-linux 2.41 series, including the lsblk filter expression option introduced upstream in 2.40.
The curated common util-linux mount listing, read-only, type, and option syntax is covered for Fedora 44.
The curated procps-ng free human-readable, byte, and refresh syntax is covered for Fedora 44.
The curated iputils ping count, interval, numeric, and IPv6 syntax is covered for Fedora 44.
The catalog exposes stable Git global invocation syntax for Fedora 44; subcommand semantics remain separately reviewable.
